name: Mint Family Dental
tagline: Gentle, modern dentistry for the whole family.
emergency_note: Toothache or broken tooth? Call before 10am for a same-day visit.

art_direction.identity: Oral-care packaging made into a website: white carton canvas, aqua-mint fields that own whole regions (hero, closing band), deep ink type set big and tight, rounded 'carton' panels, and one coral dot of warmth.
art_direction.type: Bricolage Grotesque for display (weight 600, tight tracking, large); Hanken Grotesk for text at 1rem/1.65. Numbers tabular.
art_direction.color: White canvas and ink text. bg-mint is the committed field color — use it for whole bands, never as small tints on text. bg-accent (deep ink blue) is reserved for buttons and the facts stripe. text-pop (coral) appears only as small dots, stars and the compare knob. Never add another color.
art_direction.signature: The smile compare — a before/after photo pair split by a draggable handle, with a caption tab naming the treatment and visit count. Keep it on the homepage wherever the design evolves.
art_direction.voice: Warm, plain, reassuring. Short sentences. Say what happens and what it costs. No fear, no jargon, no exclamation points.
